reason: I am moving a lot of money from a property sale, and I would rather deal with my Indian bank's NRI desk, even if it is slower. I have never heard of REPAIHUB, and a partner CA plus a partner bank is two more parties who can hold things up.
objection: What if the transfer gets stuck halfway or the CA rejects something? Then my lakhs are sitting in limbo with a company I do not know, and a fee refund does not fix that.
would_change_my_mind: My own Indian bank or my own CA confirming they work with REPAIHUB, plus a few verifiable reviews from people who moved more than 25 lakh. A written guarantee that the money is never held by REPAIHUB would also help.
